audit_status.source_base: Greek Colossians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for masters, prayer, mystery, wise speech, Tychicus/Onesimus, greetings, Archippus, final grace.

verses.restored: Masters, provide what is righteous/just and equal/fair to enslaved ones, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

familiar.text: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

verses.restored: Persevere in prayer, keeping awake in it with thanksgiving,

familiar.text: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

verses.restored: praying at the same time also concerning us, that the Divine may open to us a door of the word, to speak the mystery of Messiah, because of which I have also been bound,

familiar.text: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:

verses.restored: so that I may make it manifest, as it is necessary for me to speak.

familiar.text: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

verses.restored: Walk in wisdom toward those outside, redeeming the season.

familiar.text: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

verses.restored: Let your word always be in grace, seasoned with salt, to know how it is necessary for you to answer each one.

familiar.text: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

verses.restored: Tychicus, the beloved sibling and trustworthy servant and fellow enslaved one in the Lord, will make known to you all the things concerning me.

familiar.text: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:

verses.restored: I sent him to you for this very thing, so that you may know the things concerning us and that he may comfort/encourage your hearts,

familiar.text: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;

verses.restored: with Onesimus, the trustworthy and beloved sibling, who is from you. They will make known to you all the things here.

familiar.text: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

verses.restored: Aristarchus my fellow prisoner greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas, concerning whom you received commands; if he comes to you, receive him,

familiar.text: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)

verses.restored: and Jesus called Justus. These are from the circumcision, only these coworkers into the reign of the Divine, who became comfort/encouragement to me.

familiar.text: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.

verses.restored: Epaphras, who is from you, servant of Messiah Jesus, greets you, always struggling on your behalf in prayers, so that you may stand mature/complete and fully assured in all will of the Divine.

familiar.text: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

verses.restored: For I bear witness to him that he has much labor for you and those in Laodicea and those in Hierapolis.

familiar.text: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

verses.restored: Luke, the beloved physician, greets you, and Demas.

familiar.text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

verses.restored: Greet the siblings in Laodicea, and Nympha and the assembly in her house.

familiar.text: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.

verses.restored: And when the letter has been read among you, make it also be read in the assembly of Laodiceans, and that you also read the one from Laodicea.

familiar.text: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.

verses.restored: And say to Archippus: See the service/ministry that you received in the Lord, so that you may fulfill it.

familiar.text: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

verses.restored: The greeting by my hand, Paul's. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.

familiar.text: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

translation_notes: Colossians 4:1 continues the household code but sharply relativizes master power under the heavenly Master and calls for justice/equality.
Onesimus is named trustworthy and beloved sibling; this should be handled with dignity and in connection to Philemon.
Nympha's house-assembly is preserved as a likely woman-hosted assembly.
